screen.reason: The paper introduces PASS, an agentic multimodal framework for chest X-ray reasoning, and benchmarks it on dataset tasks (CAB-E and other benchmarks). It represents a novel agent architecture and training scheme rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice or safeguard added to an existing tool.
